note: Ten fictional requests for the slice 0 test (claude/cad-board-design.md). 'size' is the main object's overall size in millimetres; 'min' is the least number of each kind of item a correct drawing would hold.
suffix: Add a title block with the drawing's name and scale, and a short list of notes.

requests.text: Draw a floor plan of a one-bedroom flat, 9 metres by 7 metres outside. It has a living room, a bedroom, a kitchen and a bathroom, with a door to each room and the room names written inside. Show the overall dimensions.
Draw a consulting room, 4.5 metres by 3.6 metres, with a desk, two chairs, an examination couch along one wall, a wash basin and one door. Label each item and dimension the room.

Draw an open office floor, 18 metres by 12 metres, with twelve desks in three rows of four, a meeting room 5 metres by 4 metres in one corner, and a pantry. Label the rooms and show the overall dimensions.

Draw the ground floor of a small house, 10 metres by 8 metres, with outer walls 230 millimetres thick: a hall, a kitchen, two bedrooms and a bathroom, with the doors and windows marked. Write the room names and show the overall dimensions.

Draw a rectangular mounting plate, 200 millimetres by 120 millimetres, with four 10 millimetre holes, each 20 millimetres in from the corners, and a 50 millimetre hole in the centre. Front view, with centre lines and dimensions.

Draw the side view of an L-shaped bracket: 100 millimetres tall, 80 millimetres long and 8 millimetres thick, with two 9 millimetre holes through the long leg, 20 and 60 millimetres from the corner, shown as hidden lines. Dimension it.

Draw a circular flange: outside diameter 220 millimetres, bore 100 millimetres, and eight 18 millimetre bolt holes on a 180 millimetre pitch circle. Front view, with centre lines, the pitch circle on a centre linetype, and diameter dimensions.
Draw a simple wiring diagram: a 230 volt supply, a switch, a fuse and three lamps wired in parallel. Use simple symbols, label every part and number the wires.
Draw a piping run: a tank, a pump, two valves, a filter and an outlet, joined by pipes with flow arrows. Label each item and write the pipe sizes beside the pipes.

Draw a site layout: a plot 30 metres by 20 metres; a building 12 metres by 9 metres, set 5 metres in from the front boundary and 4 metres from the left boundary; a driveway 3 metres wide from the front boundary to the building; and a north arrow. Show the overall dimensions.
